viewing_check: Turn the drip vase over and photograph the base for an incised McHugh/Tasmania signature and shape number; check the rim crack length and whether it runs through. Check the large jars for makers' marks (Taddy, Bourne Denby, etc). Without a signature the vase is worth little.
